prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1200; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the collision at an intersection, in which the client's vehicle was struck on the driver's side. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. Our client has suffered injuries as a result of this impact and is pursuing a claim for the losses that followed.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a statement of any other coverage that may apply to this loss, including excess or umbrella policies.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the accident. This includes vehicle data and telematics, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, claim notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any damaged parts. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, repaired, discarded, or destroyed while the claim remains open.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within fourteen days.
